subject: Complaint regarding UPI Refund Scam involving impersonation of Amazon
body:
To,
The Cyber Cell,
National Cybercrime Reporting Portal,

I am writing to report a UPI Refund Scam that occurred on [Date and time of incident].

Incident Summary:
[Describe what happened in your words]

Scam Type: UPI Refund Scam

Details of the scammer:
Phone Number: +91 98250 11234
UPI ID: refund.help@okaxis

Financial Loss Details:
Amount Lost: [Amount lost, if any]
Payment Method: [Payment method, e.g. UPI / card / bank transfer]
Transaction ID: [Transaction ID / UTR, if any]
Total Amount involved: [Amount lost, if any]

Red Flags Identified:
- Request to enter UPI PIN to receive money
- Use of 'collect request' for a refund
- Impersonation of Amazon via WhatsApp
- Urgency / threat words (pressure to act fast)
- UPI collect request / 'enter PIN to receive money' trick
- Refund/cashback bait with a contact or link

I request you to kindly take immediate action to block the phone number (+91 98250 11234) and the UPI ID (refund.help@okaxis), and to freeze the beneficiary bank account(s) associated with these details to prevent further fraudulent activities.

Thank you for your assistance.

Sincerely,
[Your name]
[Your phone number]
